# loki.source.windowsevent produced on WANS-WINDOWS (zh-TW text, a security
# block, the two characters \r\n inside message), with every account, SID and
# credential replaced by a FAKE or fake value.
#   id      case id; it also stands in the payload, so the output can be found
#   source  System or Application (Event Log channel), or diag (runner log)
#   expect  the level label the entry must carry, or drop when it must not arrive
#   safe    yes when the stored line must equal the payload byte for byte
#   marks   comma-separated values that must not survive, - for none
#   keep    text that must survive, - for none
#   payload the line. @T@ is a timestamp of a few minutes ago and @OLD@ one of
#           three days ago, each in the source's own format; <NL> is a physical
